caption:
Mountain biking in Costa Rica means accepting that the steepest climbs rarely offer a transition—they simply turn into ridges. Here, high near the cloud forest, the gravel road narrows to a single grassy line where the Pacific breeze meets the continental divide. Your legs feel every vertical metre, but the reward is a stillness that no highway can provide. There are no engines up here, just the click of a freehub and the sound of your own breathing as the valley opens up below. Send this to the friend who'd ride it with you.
